style: Use the user-approved 2026-11-22 Gajendra Moksham full-body nine-character cast sheet exactly: warm painted Prahlada-style Indian devotional storybook art, gently simplified anatomy, bright but restrained colors; crocodile visibly firm/fierce without gore or horror. This project-specific identity set is approved; do not redesign it.
global_rules: Gajendra and crocodile are normal quadruped/low-slung animal bodies until the narratively explicit divine transformation; no human mouth motion.
Indradyumna is Gajendra's former human birth; Huhu is crocodile's former Gandharva birth. Keep separate physical identities and preserve narrative revelation.
Narayana's four-arm iconography and Gajendra's later four-arm spiritual form must not mix identities or creature anatomy.
Trikuta three-peak silhouette and one lake land/water master geography remain stable.
Portraits, voice auditions and image refs are not approved until actual media hashes and reviewer decisions exist.
No blood, visible wounds, grotesque violence or inaccurate new creature anatomy.

Nine approved full-body character identities are source-locked to the owner-approved composite PNG SHA-256 389568f7590fe2230892c0de3aaafde88f256f4a50e4e4a54ddd65071e4cab06 and its lossless crops stored in the project's ChatGPT Library. Existing text descriptions yield to approved image identity for approved costume/styling details; never infer additional generated views.

An approved cast overview does not mean episode scene stills, 3-view turnarounds, environment masters, TTS, or motion have been produced or approved. Cropped panels are derivatives of the one approved image.

GAJENDRA.design: Approved full-body stylized Indian elephant: natural four legs, raised trunk, two stable tusks, friendly expressive eyes, soft grey-lavender skin, decorative red-gold patterned saddle cloth, small ceremonial gold headband and ornaments. Keep exactly his sheet identity, scale, ears, trunk, tusks and four legs; no human hands, no realistic skin photo-texture.
GAJENDRA.performance: Expresses effort/concern through natural behavior and prayer via inner voiceover, not lip-synced human mouth.
GAJENDRA.approval_scope: User-approved visual character identity from single full-body composite 2026-11-22; not separate turnaround or production image QC
